```yaml
name: CI Pipeline

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  ci-checks:
    runs-on: macos-latest
    
    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v4
    
    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v4
      with:
        python-version: '3.11'
    
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install pytest ruff
        pip install -e .
    
    - name: Run pytest
      run: pytest
    
    - name: Run ruff check
      run: ruff check
    
    - name: Run path consistency check
      run: bash scripts/check-path-consistency.sh
    
    - name: Run distribution verification
      run: bash scripts/verify-distribution.sh
```
